Alex K: Morning team — quick async standup on gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits. Drop 1) what you did yesterday 2) blockers 3) today. Ping @Kevin @Samir

Marta: Yesterday: rolled routing policy v3 to staging for a subset of tenants. Blocker: auth e2e failing against service-b (lots of 403s). Today: digging into token exchange and adding debug logs. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/7123 — would love a quick review.

Kevin: Yesterday: patched JWT expiry parsing (PR #7104 merged). No blockers. Today: will review Marta's PR + cut a hotfix if e2e doesn't stabilize. Quick test: `make test-auth`

Samir: Yesterday: ran load tests on rate-limiter, found token-bucket leak when burst > 2000 reqs. Blocker: need burst_limit surfaced to configmap for canary. Today: spike to wire `burst_limit` to env and run smoke. Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --env staging --focus=rate-limiter`

Tanya: Yesterday: renamed metrics on dashboard (rate-limiter.latency -> rate_limiter.request_latency). Blocker: existing alert rules still reference old metric names and are firing. Today: update alerts + coordinate with oncall to suppress noisy alerts during canary.

CJ: Yesterday: reviewed routing tests and left comments. Blocker: none. Today: will do a quick pairing session at 15:00 to help debug e2e failures (ping @Marta). I'm OOO after 16:30 so will handle reviews this morning.

Marta: quick log sample showing 403 from auth-proxy — adding to PR for context:
```
[auth-proxy] 2026-03-17T09:12:02Z svc=service-b request_id=abc123 status=403 reason=token-exchange-failed
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://staging-gw.redwood/api/service-b/health
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for gateway-policy v3 on staging at 1987654335. Rollout: 3/12 hosts updated, health checks passing so far.

Kevin: reviewed PR #7123, left two nits on variable naming, otherwise looks good. :thumbsup: Will merge once the e2e collection finishes.

Samir: I'll add the configmap change and post the diff here, pinging @Tanya for the alert name mapping.

Alex K: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. If e2e flips to green, let's promote the canary. If you hit an urgent blocker call me or DM.
